title: Verification and Validation Plan / Test Report
purpose: Plan, execute and report objective evidence that requirements and mission needs are satisfied.

sections.title: Purpose: Scope and Authority
sections.instruction: Test item, objectives, boundaries, authority, applicable baseline and exclusions.

sections.title: References and Configuration
sections.instruction: Requirements, design baseline, procedures, software/firmware, hardware serials, calibration and environmental conditions.

sections.title: Verification Strategy
sections.instruction: Map each requirement to inspection, analysis, demonstration, simulation, SIL, HIL or physical test. Justify method and fidelity.

sections.title: Test Environment and Equipment
sections.instruction: Facility, instruments, calibration, fixtures, software, network, environmental conditions and safety controls.

sections.title: Test Cases and Procedures
sections.instruction: Preconditions, setup, steps, input data, expected results, tolerances, abort criteria and evidence capture.

sections.title: Execution Record
sections.instruction: Date/time, operator, configuration, deviations, actual observations, logs and run identifiers.

sections.title: Results and Disposition
sections.instruction: Pass/fail/blocked per requirement, measured values, uncertainty, anomalies, retests and waivers.

sections.title: Analysis and Limitations
sections.instruction: Explain what evidence proves and does not prove. Do not infer field reliability from a short bench test.

sections.title: Defects and Corrective Action
sections.instruction: Issue ID, severity, root cause, owner, corrective action, retest and closure evidence.

sections.title: Review and Approval
sections.instruction: Independent review, witness, acceptance authority, open deviations and release decision.

sections.title: Appendices
sections.instruction: Raw data, plots, photos, calibration certificates, scripts, logs and signed checklists.
